scenarios.task: Pull low-voltage conduit and Cat-6A for the DAO display wall in Charter Hall.
steps: Verify lockout/tagout on nearby panels
Measure and cut EMT conduit with proper bender
Secure conduit runs with straps every 10 ft
Pull conductors with fish tape, keeping tension even
Terminate and test each run with a certifier
Clean up scrap and coil leftover cable

rubric.pass_if: Applies and verifies lockout before working near live panels
Conduit runs are strapped, bent without kinks, and pass certification
Aisle clear of reels and scrap at task end

scenarios.task: Fabricate and hang stainless exhaust duct for a new fume hood in the lab.
steps: Review shop drawings and confirm hood location
Fabricate duct sections with flanged joints
Seal seams per spec and deburr all edges
Raise sections with lift and hand lines
Bolt, align, and torque flange connections
Pressure-test duct and record results

rubric.pass_if: Deburr all edges and gloves worn during handling
Harness tied off and load communicated to crew
Duct passes pressure test with no leaks

scenarios.robot_role: Holds and rotates duct sections during flange bolting to reduce manual handling of sharp edges.

scenarios.task: Replace old fluorescents with LED panels in the Proposal Forum ceiling.
steps: De-energize lighting circuits and verify with meter
Remove old fixtures and cap wires properly
Set and wire LED panels per drawing
Secure panels to grid frame
Restore power and test all fixtures

rubric.pass_if: Tests de-energized circuits with a meter before touching conductors
Panels seated flush and secured without damaging ceiling grid
Old lamps placed in lamp recycling, not general trash

scenarios.task: Tie in chilled-water piping for a cooling unit serving the Operations Deck.
steps: Isolate and drain the existing chilled water loop
Cut and fit new pipe spools to the unit
Brazed joints under a valid hot-work permit with fire watch
Pressure-test joints and inspect for leaks
Insulate new piping to spec
Return loop to service and document

rubric.pass_if: Permit issued and fire watch maintained during brazing
Pressure test held and inspected before insulation
Records test pressures and signs off the tie-in

scenarios.task: Patch EPDM membrane on the observatory roof after a storm.
hazards: weather exposure on Cam floodplain site
steps: Set up warning lines and anchor points
Locate and mark punctures
Clean and prime repair areas
Apply EPDM patches with roller, lapping correctly
Inspect seams and remove tools
Complete a weather check before descent

rubric.pass_if: Stays inside warning line or ties off when within 6 ft of edge
Patches fully bonded with no fishmouths or bubbles
Stops work if rain or wind picks up

scenarios.task: Stabilize eroded riverbank walkway edge along the Cam near the campus grounds.
steps: Inspect bank and mark access route away from soft spots
Load riprap with wheelbarrow or mini-loader
Place stone by hand, keying into bank
Backfill and compact edges
Restore turf and clean walkway

rubric.pass_if: Never works on unstable bank edge; stays on marked route
Stone keyed and interlocked, not dumped loose
Grass reinstated and path left clear of mud

scenarios.robot_role: Shuttles riprap from stockpile to bank so crew avoids repetitive heavy carries on soft ground.

scenarios.task: Test and balance airflow on lab fume hoods after duct modifications.
hazards: working at height on step platform
steps: Confirm hood sash and baffles are set correctly
Measure face velocity with calibrated anemometer
Record readings across a grid of the sash opening
Adjust damper and re-measure
Log results and tag hood status

rubric.pass_if: Face velocity within spec at every grid point
Uses a calibrated, in-date anemometer
Logs results and applies clear pass/fail tag

scenarios.task: Rig and set the large charter display screen in the Proposal Forum atrium.
steps: Verify load weight and rigging gear ratings
Inspect slings and shackles before use
Attach tag lines and confirm exclusion zone
Direct crane with standard hand signals
Guide and set display onto anchors
Remove rigging and secure the unit

rubric.pass_if: Rejects any damaged sling or shackle before lift
Uses standard signals and keeps exclusion zone clear
Load set on anchors without shock loading or contact damage
